title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Fort Wayne, Indiana | PetTripFinder
meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Fort Wayne, Indiana, with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
_pending_note: PROPOSED, NOT REGISTERED. This file sits in markets/pending/ on purpose: launch_packages/pettripfinder/markets/*.json IS the production market registry, and load_markets() globs it, so dropping this file one directory up would register Fort Wayne into every assembly, manifest and sitemap the moment it landed. PTF-FORT-WAYNE-IN-NEW-MARKET-001 is a market-local order and must not cross that boundary; the promotion order moves this file up. The same convention is what test_st_louis_production_safety_001 asserts was cleaned up after St. Louis was promoted.
_boundary_note: PTF-FORT-WAYNE-IN-NEW-MARKET-001 visitor market: the City of Fort Wayne, the Allen County lodging clusters that serve it, Fort Wayne International Airport (FWA), and New Haven on the US-30/IN-930 east corridor. Corridors were drawn from OBSERVED lodging concentration (an OpenStreetMap sweep of Allen County plus the Allen County CVB directory and the Marriott and Hilton inventories), not from a municipal line or the full MSA. EXCLUDED: Warsaw (Marriott issues it the FWA-prefixed code fwafw and it is NOT this market), Huntington, Columbia City, Decatur, Bluffton, Auburn, Angola, Kendallville and Van Wert OH. THE POSTAL PARTITION IS DELIBERATELY INCOMPLETE: ZIP 46825 spans three different traveller decisions -- the Washington Center Road cluster, the Dupont Road / I-69 cluster about eight kilometres north of it, and the Purdue Fort Wayne campus -- so 46825 is attached to NO corridor and its hotels are assigned explicitly, exactly as Pittsburgh handles 15205 and 15219. That split is also why this market declares census_membership_basis MARKET_GEOGRAPHY: its boundary is its committed discovery geography (scripts/pettripfinder/discovery/config/fort_wayne_in.json), and corridors only classify what is already in. This market publishes nothing in this work order.
